videos.title: 🎬 Video URLs or IDs
videos.description: Watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live URLs or bare video IDs. Channel/playlist URLs pasted here are expanded too.

channels.title: 📺 Channels or playlists
channels.description: Channel URLs or @handles (latest videos) and playlist URLs. Comments of their videos are scraped.

searchTerms.title: 🔎 Search terms
searchTerms.description: Scrape comments from the top video results of these YouTube searches.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel / playlist / search
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many videos to take from each channel, playlist or search term.

maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max top-level comments per video
maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Stop after this many top-level comments on each video.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Also scrape replies to each comment (each reply counts as one result).

maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max replies per comment
maxRepliesPerComment.description: Only used when replies are included.

maxComments.title: Max results in total (optional)
maxComments.description: Hard cap on comments + replies scraped (and charged) in this run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter) is used by default.

residentialFallback.title: Residential proxy fallback
residentialFallback.description: Retry blocked requests through residential proxy (no extra cost to you).
